name: AI UI Style Vault Runtime Index
purpose: Keep agent context small by routing each task to only the files needed for the current stage.

sourceIngestion.when: user provides a Google Maps/business/site/social/directory URL or structured business-source evidence
read: the single source playbook selected by the URL router
produce: business-source-request.json when URL research is required
sourceIngestion.rule: Verified/source values are not rewritten or substituted. Reviews marked verbatim remain exact. Unsupported fields stay omitted/empty. Read only the selected source playbook, not all playbooks.

contentModel.when: a source-ingestion bundle exists and the build may need evidence-backed public content structure or admin/CMS functionality
contentModel.rule: Only evidenced entities become public/CMS records. Missing evidence never creates placeholder operational modules, sample data or dashboard statistics.

research.when: real business, brand, organisation, venue, product or service without a completed source-ingestion bundle

plan.rule: Only expand into selected requiredReads and recipes.

components.when: interaction or component semantics are non-trivial

immersiveTemplates.when: the user asks for an immersive website, experiential landing page, scrollytelling site, interactive world, spatial showcase or similarly experience-led architecture
immersiveTemplates.command: python scripts/vault-agent.py immersive business-profile.json --goal "<actual user goal>"
immersiveTemplates.rule: None is valid. Select the architecture before loading source references. Reuse source code only within the recorded licence boundary; reference-only sources contribute principles, not implementation.

effects.when: the static/component composition is valid and an interactive enhancement may materially support the page purpose
read: references/threeui-community.json only when reference research is needed
effects.rule: None is a first-class result. Business purpose, accessibility, mobile behavior and measured performance outrank novelty. Route to 3D when the subject becomes explorable/configurable/spatially meaningful.

3d.when: 3D is justified by subject and user goal, including when a selected immersive template requires a primary spatial interaction
3d.rule: Do not load the full 478-recipe registry unless selection needs it. An immersive template does not automatically justify 3D.

3dMode.when: 3D has been justified and the agent must decide whether the experience is visual-only, authored animation, directly inspectable, configurable, spatially explorable or a full interactive world
3dMode.rule: This stage is mandatory before 3D production/runtime selection. Classify from the user interaction goal, never from file extension. A GLB/GLTF never automatically implies free rotation. A 360 drag/swipe inspection request remains inspectable-object even when the model still needs to be produced.

3dProductionResources.when: the selected 3D mode requires real geometry or scene assets and the required approved production asset does not yet exist
3dProductionResources.rule: Resource discovery never changes the selected 3D mode and never justifies 3D. Select a production category, then verify each external candidate's licence/terms, maintenance, compatibility, security and asset provenance.

3dDeliveryRuntime.when: the mandatory 3D mode has been selected and an approved web-ready GLB/glTF exists for a mode that needs a browser 3D runtime
3dDeliveryRuntime.rule: Runtime selection must consume the already-selected mode. visual-only does not become rotatable because a GLB exists; inspectable/configurable modes may use <model-viewer> when bounded; spatial-exploration and interactive-world escalate to a custom runtime.

commands: python scripts/vault-agent.py effect-qa <effect-id> EFFECT_QA_OBSERVATIONS.json when an effect is selected

studio.when: a human or agent needs a compact browse index instead of reading the full reference archive
studio.rule: Studio browsing never bypasses business research, semantic effect/immersive/3D selection, the 3D mode gate or source/licence boundaries.

mcp.when: a local MCP-capable coding agent needs compact read-only effect, immersive-template, 3D-mode, production-resource or delivery-runtime discovery/selection and skill retrieval
mcp.rule: The MCP adapter is local/read-only; 3D delivery selection requires a classified mode and it does not perform business-source web research, install third-party resources, write files or bypass entitlements.

contextBudgetRules: For business URLs, ingest source evidence before design catalogs.
Generate the content/CMS model before inventing an admin structure.
Load exactly one source-specific extraction playbook for the primary URL unless a second source is explicitly inspected.
Select the immersive architecture before opening any immersive source implementation; none is valid.
Select an interactive effect before opening any external effect implementation; none is valid.
Classify the 3D mode before searching for production tools or choosing a 3D runtime.
Never infer inspectable/configurable behavior from GLB/GLTF availability alone.
Select a 3D production category before opening external Blender/tool/asset sources; verify each linked resource independently.
Select a 3D delivery profile only after the mode gate and before reading model-viewer implementation examples.
Never preload the full Awesome Blender list or all linked production resources.
Never preload all 2,671 Component Gallery examples.
Never preload all captured styles or screen references.
Prefer a generated plan containing file pointers over duplicated prose.
A selected pack's requiredReads are authoritative for that task; unrelated packs stay out of context.
